verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a documented command-line tool that reads from files, pipes and network streams, so it runs headlessly by design. Community reports confirm unattended automation, including a real-time Whisper transcription pipeline feeding a live website, batch-file wrappers, and a single-process motion-detection setup driven by filtergraph files. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/container guidance, evidence of non-interactive flags (e.g. overwrite/no-stdin behavior), and relief from the shell-escaping friction users report when scripting complex commands.
